{{Quote|My master deserves justice, but there are more noble ways to have it. I will destroy you personally. Come. Face me. If I win, I've done my duty. If you win, you'll have the new code.|Praven|<ref name="Duel" />}}
During the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|crusade of revenge]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] in [[3643 BBY]], a '''duel''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] between Angral's apprentice Lord [[Praven]] and the [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who had slain Tarnis. Desiring justice for Tarnis's death but disagreeing with his Master's dishonorable order to destroy the deactivation codes for the [[Shock Drum]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and therefore prevent the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from stopping the active weapon from destroying Tatooine, Praven challenged the Knight to a duel for the codes on the [[Esus Mesa]]. The duel ended with Praven's defeat at the hands of the Knight, but the Jedi refused to kill the honorable warrior and convinced him to abandon the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and become a Jedi, and the Knight then departed to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] region in order to deactivate the Shock Drum weapon while Praven surrendered himself to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==The duel==
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was attempting to deactivate the stolen [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Shock Drum]], and Praven had offered to give up the deactivation codes if the Knight could defeat him. After receiving Praven's offer, the Knight and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] traveled into the rock formations separating the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They arrived at the [[Esus Mesa]], where they found the Sith Lord waiting for them.<ref name="The Shock Drum" />

Praven informed the Knight that he was [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis's]] master, and that he should have trained his apprentice better. The Knight attempted to convince the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] to turn away from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], appealing to the Sith's strong values of honor and courage, but Praven believed that the Jedi and the Sith held no common ground. Forced to duel, the Knight and their Padawan were able to defeat Praven, but the Jedi refused to strike down the wounded Sith.<ref name="Duel" />

The Jedi appealed to Praven again, asking him to reject the dark side and embrace the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]. The Knight swore to him that he would be accepted into the ranks of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and that his past did not matter&mdash;only his choices now. Convinced, Praven accepted the Knight's offer, and gave them the deactivation codes as per their agreement. He told the pair that he would contact the Republic and the Jedi, as he was too injured to aid the Knight. The Jedi continued on into the Dune Sea, determined to destroy the Shock Drum.<ref name="Duel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel on the Esus Mesa appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The mission "Desert Duel" serves as the first major boss battle on the planet Tatooine for the Jedi Knight class, followed by the battle with the [[sand demon]] in the Shock Drum facility.<ref name="The Sand Demon">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Sand Demon|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="Duel" /> [[Robert Chestney]] developed the scenario behind the mission, and [[Hall Hood]] wrote the dialogue for the conversation.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/321973883106377728|[[Hall Hood]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>
